newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen B shares close up 10.49 pct at year-high.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen B shares close up 10.49 pct at year-high.

text.p: Shenzhen's B share index soared 10.49 percent to a year-high close in heavy trading on Monday as investors poured money into a market that has been on a bull run over the past two weeks, brokers said.
The B index surged 14.97 points to end at its year-high closing level of 157.68, slightly off its intra-session high of 158.67.
Turnover rose to HK$564.20 million from Friday's HK$348.97 million. All 43 Shenzhen-listed B stocks gained.

Investors hastened to build positions in B shares on hopes that securities regulators might take measures to boost the market by the end of this year and that earnings of listed firms would pick up due to lower interest rates, brokers said.
Sentiment became increasingly bullish, with no sign of government intervention to cool the market and institutions the main traders, they said.
Buying is likely to focus on counters expected to report healthy earnings for this year, one analyst said.
"But trading is getting growingly speculative and is likely to be volatile in the coming sessions," he said.
One broker said that, because of the limited size of the B market, some counters are being manipulated by financially strong institutions.
Changan Automobile, the day's star, soared HK$1.04, or 27.66 percent, to HK$4.80 on the session's heaviest trade of 16.27 million shares due to speculative demand by institutions, brokers said.
Dadonghai followed suit, rising HK$0.70 or 20.33 percent to HK$4.16 on volume of 9.44 million shares.
Real estate developer Pearl River climbed HK$0.59 or 18.50 percent to HK$3.78 after 5.26 million shares were traded.
Textile share Victor Onward gained HK$0.55 or 17.19 percent to HK$3.75. Diesel engine maker Changchai, the third most active issue, rose HK$0.78 to HK$6.85, with 6.69 million shares changing hands.
The A market edged lower as funds continued to move out of Shenzhen to Shanghai, brokers said.

The A index shed 3.35 points, or 0.75 percent, to 442.07, with turnover falling to 8.21 billion yuan from 9.29 billion the previous session. The composite index lost 1.08 points, or 0.26 percent, to 418.55.
Steel pipe maker Zhongyuan slid 0.83 yuan, or 5.40 percent, to 14.55 yuan on institutional selling, brokers said.
Recently listed Dongyuan Steel dropped 0.70 yuan, or 5.33 percent, to 12.44 yuan due to profit-taking.
